sloka: हर्षजानि च सोऽश्रूणि ताम् दृष्ट्वा मदिरेक्षणाम् ।मुमुचे हनुमांस्तत्र नमश्चक्रे च राघवम् ।। ५-१७-३१।।
transliteration: harṣajāni ca so'śrūṇi tām dṛṣṭvā madirekṣaṇām ।mumuce hanumāṁstatra namaścakre ca rāghavam ।। 5-17-31।।

translations.english: Seeing that lady with eyes intoxicating, Hanuman shed tears of joy. At once he paid obeisance to Rama. (thinking he could trace Sita at last).
